scripts.dev: npm run build -w @shopro/contracts && concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,blue "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @shopro/contracts && npm run build -w @shopro/api && npm run build -w @shopro/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @shopro/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @shopro/api && npm run typecheck -w @shopro/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @shopro/contracts && npm run test -w @shopro/api && npm run test -w @shopro/web && npm run test:backup
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @shopro/contracts && npm run build -w @shopro/api && node scripts/test-document-sequence-upgrade-postgres.mjs && node scripts/test-otp-postgres.mjs && node scripts/test-document-sequence-postgres.mjs && node scripts/test-financial-posting-postgres.mjs && node scripts/test-http-authorization-postgres.mjs && node scripts/test-receivable-pagination-postgres.mjs
